_about: Hand-checked against Oshlack/STRetch at ce74895ad7b469a43972c9571009fea8cb1fe39c (tag v0.4.0) on 2026-09-29, from README.md, the GitHub wiki it links to as the user guide (Installing-STRetch, Running-STRetch, Reference-data, Output-files, Troubleshooting; wiki HEAD 79e6afd, 2019-04-23), install.sh, environment.yml and pipelines/*.groovy at that commit, api.anaconda.org and the v0.4.0 release.

program.where: https://github.com/Oshlack/STRetch/wiki/Running-STRetch (Running-STRetch.md:36); bpipe is put in tools/bin by install.sh:32-36

install.documented: git clone, then ./install.sh (needs Git and Java); it fetches bpipe 0.9.9.5, Miniconda plus environment.yml, bwakit, samtools 1.8, bazam and picard, downloads the ~8 GB hg19 reference bundle, and writes pipelines/pipeline_config.groovy

published.where: https://api.anaconda.org/package/bioconda/stretch (not found); https://github.com/Oshlack/STRetch/releases/tag/v0.4.0 (no assets); neither README.md nor the wiki mentions Bioconda, a container image or a binary

extra_inputs.what: STR-decoy reference genome (genome FASTA with STRdecoys.fasta appended, sorted) plus its BWA index, .fai and .genome file (pipeline_config REF)
genome-wide STR annotation BED for that reference: chrom, start, end, motif, reference copy number; deduplicated and sorted (pipeline_config STR_BED)
BED of the STR decoy chromosomes (pipeline_config DECOY_BED)

input_regions BED listing ALL STRs in the genome the BAM was aligned to (hg38 here), e.g. hg38.simpleRepeat_period1-6.dedup.sorted.bed, used by bazam -L to pull reads for remapping; STRhub's plain BED4 has the right coordinates and layout but only the 24 panel loci
control set for outlier scores (pipeline_config CONTROL), e.g. hg19.PCRfreeWGS_143_STRetch_controls.tsv from the hg19 bundle; without it a single sample gets sizes but no z-scores or p-values

runnable_on_strhub_data.why: STRetch needs STR-decoy reference data (decoy FASTA with BWA index and .genome file, decoy BED, genome-wide STR annotation) and, for the BAM pipeline, an input_regions BED of all STRs in hg38. STRhub holds only the plain hg38 FASTA and a 24-locus BED4. install.sh fetches decoy data for hg19 only; hg38 data must be built by hand (wiki Reference-data).

notes: Usage lives only in the GitHub wiki (README.md:5,21-22). The snapshot's wiki/ has only Home.md, which holds neither install nor run instructions; those are on Installing-STRetch and Running-STRetch, reached from the wiki sidebar. The wiki's Quick start (Running-STRetch.md:5) is the paired-end WGS FASTQ pipeline (STRetch_wgs_pipeline.groovy, files ending _R1/_R2.fastq.gz). STRhub has no paired-end WGS FASTQ (illumina-str-fastq is a single ForenSeq amplicon file), so the faithful fit is the WGS BAM pipeline on illumina-bam-hg38. The genotyping step itself is scripts/estimateSTR.py, which bpipe runs (pipelines/pipeline_stages.groovy:194-218). Ambiguity: the wiki allows input_regions to match the BAM's assembly while the rest of the pipeline uses another (Running-STRetch.md:46). So install.sh's hg19 bundle, with STRhub's 24-locus BED4 as input_regions, would probably run and report hg19 coordinates. That breaks the documented rule that input_regions must list all STRs in the genome, so it is recorded as a workaround, not a faithful run. The exome BAM pipeline with EXOME_TARGET (Running-STRetch.md:61-65) is the documented option for targeted data. On 2026-09-29 the figshare zip URL in install.sh:74 returned HTTP 502; the bundle's files are still listed at https://api.figshare.com/v2/articles/4658701. 'script' here means running install.sh. environment.yml alone (Installing-STRetch.md:49-53) covers only the Python deps, bedtools, goleft and mosdepth; it leaves out bpipe, BWA, samtools, Picard, Bazam and the reference data. The wiki's clone command uses SSH (Installing-STRetch.md:11). The wiki was edited after the release (2019-01-24 and 2019-04-23); the citations are from its current HEAD.
